Viral hepatitis
Patients with acute viral hepatitis are generally not at risk for nutritional deﬁciencies but they do experience anorexia and cholestasis
resulting in a brief period of malabsorption. Patients chronically infected with hepatitis B and C viruses (HBV, HCV) may develop
cirrhosis over 10–20 years with of the potential to develop hepatocellular carcinoma. Patients with chronic viral infection with
